lines.en: label day128:
scene street_noon
Another day nears its end as I make my way down the streets of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 又一天接近尾声，我正走在 Kumon-mi 的街道上。

lines.en: Ami’s club is having a meeting today, so I’m walking back alone and looking for some way to kill time.
lines.zh: Ami 的社团今天有活动，所以我一个人往回走，找点事打发时间。

lines.en: Fortunately, it’s Friday, so I don’t have to worry about doing anything productive for at least two more days.
lines.zh: 所幸今天是周五，所以至少还有两天不用操心干任何正事。

lines.en: With how shitty the weather’s been in terms of heat, though, part of me just wants to lock myself inside and wait for winter to arrive.
lines.zh: 不过天气热得这么操蛋，我有一部分只想把自己锁在屋里，等冬天到来。

lines.en: I wonder if this whole {i}world resetting{/i} thing means that I’m going to be trapped inside perpetual-summer for the rest of eternity?
lines.zh: 我在想，整个{i}世界重置{/i}这回事，是不是意味着我要被困在永恒的夏天里，直到永远？

lines.en: I sure hope not.
lines.zh: 我真希望不是。

lines.en: Summer fucking sucks and should go away.
lines.zh: 夏天他妈的烂透了，赶紧滚吧。

lines.en: Except for bathing suits. Those can stay.
lines.zh: 泳装除外。那个可以留下。

lines.en: scene chikayumi1
: Oh, hey! What are you doing over here, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿！Sensei，你在这儿干什么呢？

lines.en: I suddenly stumble across Chika and Yumi making their way home from[school].
lines.zh: 我突然撞见 Chika 和 Yumi 正从[school]往家走。

lines.en: Well, Chika is making her way home from[school]. I don't even think Yumi has shown up since she stormed out of class the other day.
lines.zh: 好吧，是 Chika 从[school]往家走。Yumi 那天冲出教室之后，我觉得她根本就没来过。

lines.en: scene chikayumi2
: Hey, you two. I'm just...doing the same thing you're doing, I guess- heading home after a long day of working hard and preparing you for the outside world.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们俩。我只是……在干和你们一样的事吧——辛苦了一天，把你们培养成能面对外面世界的人，然后回家。

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounded believable.
lines.zh: : 是啊，听起来真可信。

lines.en: : No plans for the rest of the day?
lines.zh: : 今天剩下的时间没什么安排吗？

lines.en: : Nothing in particular. How about you guys?
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的。你们呢？

lines.en: scene chikayumi3
: Well, I obvs can't speak for Yumi, but I’ve got a night shift later.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我 obviously 不能替 Yumi 说话，不过我晚点有夜班。

lines.en: : So, the two of us were just gonna walk back to my place and she was gonna look after Chinami while I go rake in that sweet minimum wage.
lines.zh: : 所以我们俩本来打算走回我家，让她在我去赚那点可怜的最低工资时照看 Chinami。

lines.en: : Is it really okay for Chinami to be alone so often?
lines.zh: : Chinami 这么经常一个人待着，真的没问题吗？

lines.en: scene chikayumi4
: Yeah, she’s totally fine. She spends the day alone whenever Yumi and I both come to school anyway. I just hate putting her through that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她完全没事。反正我和 Yumi 都来上学的时候，她也是一个人过一天。我只是不喜欢让她这么熬。

lines.en: : I’d be crazy bored if I were stuck inside the house for that long. It's just kind of in my nature to always be doing stuff, I guess.
lines.zh: : 要是被困在屋里那么久，我得无聊疯了。我大概天生就是闲不住，必须一直有点事做。

lines.en: : Yeah well, I wouldn't expect anything different from the social butterfly of the class.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也没指望班上的社交蝴蝶会有什么不同。

lines.en: scene chikayumi5
: Aww, you’re comparing me to a butterfly now? That’s so sweet~
lines.zh: : 哇哦，你现在把我比作蝴蝶啦？好贴心哦~

lines.en: : But now I have to think about what sort of animal I'd compare you-
lines.zh: : 那现在我得想想该把你比作什么动物——

lines.en: : Oh, give it a fuckin’ rest already.
lines.zh: : 哦，你能不能他妈的消停点。

lines.en: scene chikayumi6
: Oh. Sorry, Yumi. I apologize for having fun without you.
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉，Yumi。我为自己丢下你一个人开心道歉。

lines.en: : Ain't somethin' to apologize for. I'm just fucking fed up with hearing everybody say all this nice shit about him all the time.
lines.zh: : 没什么好道歉的。我只是他妈的听够了所有人一天到晚说他好话。

lines.en: scene chikayumi7
: Uhhh...I don’t really know what’s going on, but it’s, like...way rude to talk about somebody like that when they’re right in front of you.
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道发生了什么，不过……当着人家的面说那种话，真的超级没礼貌。

lines.en: : Yumi’s got a point, Chika. I’m really not as great as you make me out to be.
lines.zh: : Yumi 说得有道理，Chika。我真没你说的那么好。

lines.en: scene chikayumi8
: What are you talking about? You’re the best teacher I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？你是我遇到过最好的老师。

lines.en: : Thanks for that. But if there was any amount of truth to it, the girl beside you would be coming to[school] every day.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。不过要是这话有半点属实，你旁边那女孩就该每天都来[school]了。

lines.en: : I’ve got a name, douchebag. Don’t just fuckin’ call me ‘the girl.’ Shit’s degrading as fuck.
lines.zh: : 我有名字，蠢货。别他妈叫我「那个女孩」。这他妈的侮辱人。

lines.en: scene chikayumi10
: Yeah, so like...I wasn’t trying to start something between you two, so...can we maybe try to tone it down a little bit?
lines.zh: : 是啊，那个……我也不是想挑起你们俩之间的事，所以……能不能稍微收敛一点？

lines.en: : I love both of you guys and I’d like, mega appreciate it if we could all just be friends and...you know, {i}not{/i} curse at each other in public.
lines.zh: : 你们俩我都很喜欢，如果大家能和和气气做朋友……你知道，{i}别{/i}在公共场合互骂，我会超级感激的。

lines.en: : Fine by me. I like both of you as well.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。你们俩我也都喜欢。

lines.en: scene chikayumi11
: Yeah. Right.
lines.zh: : 是啊。说得对。

lines.en: : Like I'm going to believe that.
lines.zh: : 我信你才有鬼。

lines.en: : Okay, seriously...what is going on with you all of a sudden? You were fine like, two minutes ago. What the Hell happened within that time?
lines.zh: : 好了，说真的……你突然这是怎么了？两分钟前你还好好的。那会儿到底发生了什么？

lines.en: : Nothing happened. Nothing ever happens.
lines.zh: : 什么都没发生。什么事都不会发生。

lines.en: : Just keep fuckin’ chattin’ up a storm over there and I’ll go back to bein’ the third wheel.
lines.zh: : 你们就继续他妈的聊得热火朝天吧，我继续当我的电灯泡。

lines.en: : How are you a third wheel? You came all the way to[school] to meet me. It’s not like I’m gonna ignore you just ‘cause Sensei is here now.
lines.zh: : 你怎么会是电灯泡？你可是专门跑到[school]来接我的。Sensei 现在在这儿，我又不会因此就不理你。

lines.en: : Should I maybe leave the two of you alone? I can’t help but feel like my presence isn’t entirely wanted here.
lines.zh: : 要不我留你们俩单独待着？我忍不住觉得我在这里不太受欢迎。

lines.en: scene chikayumi12
: No, don't leave just yet!
lines.zh: : 不，先别走！

lines.en: : In fact, while you're here, I think the two of you should make up or...settle your differences or whatever so we can all walk back to my place together.
lines.zh: : 事实上，趁你在这儿，我觉得你们俩该和好，或者……解决一下分歧什么的，这样我们三个就能一起走回我家了。

lines.en: scene chikayumi13
: What?! Are you kidding?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你开玩笑吧？！

lines.en: : You’re really gonna show this guy where Chinami lives? Doesn’t that horrify you?
lines.zh: : 你真要带这家伙去看 Chinami 住的地方？你不怕吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. Sensei’s already been over before.
lines.zh: : 当然不怕。Sensei 之前就来过了。

lines.en: scene chikayumi14
: You let him inside?! Are you out of your mind?!
lines.zh: : 你让他进屋了？！你疯了吗？！

lines.en: : Okay, you know what? I’m just gonna-
lines.zh: : 好了，这样吧，我就——

lines.en: scene chikayumi15
: Oh, no you don’t, mister! You’re not going anywhere. Not until I'm confident that you don't want to kill each other anymore.
lines.zh: : 哦，不行，先生！你哪儿都别想去。除非我确信你们俩不再想杀了对方。

lines.en: : I've never wanted to-
lines.zh: : 我从来没想过——

lines.en: : Save your fucking breath, asshole. There ain't no convincing her when she gets like this. Just gotta sit back and wait for whatever lame ass plan she comes up with.
lines.zh: : 省省你的力气吧，混蛋。她这样的时候谁也劝不动。你就坐着等她想出什么烂计划吧。

lines.en: : My {i}lame ass plan{/i} is that the three of us are going out for dinner.
lines.zh: : 我的{i}烂计划{/i}是，我们三个一起出去吃晚饭。

lines.en: scene chikayumi16
: Dude, don’t you have like...work and shit, though?
lines.zh: : 拜托，你不是还有……工作什么的吗？

lines.en: : Okay, change of plans.
lines.zh: : 好吧，计划改一下。

lines.en: : The two of {i}you{/i} are going out for dinner together.
lines.zh: : {i}你们俩{/i}一起出去吃晚饭。

lines.en: scene chikayumi17
: That was a joke, right?
lines.zh: : 那是在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : Chika, please tell me that was a joke.
lines.zh: : Chika，请告诉我那是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : It was not a joke, Yumi. There’s a place not far from my apartment where the two of you are going to hang out and talk about your feelings.
lines.zh: : 不是开玩笑，Yumi。离我公寓不远有个地方，你们俩要去那儿待着，好好谈谈你们的感受。

lines.en: : Feelings? From this guy? Do you actually think he has any?
lines.zh: : 感受？从这家伙身上？你真觉得他有那玩意儿？

lines.en: : I mean, I’m okay with it if Yumi is.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果 Yumi 没意见，我也没意见。

lines.en: scene chikayumi18
: Does it look like I’m fucking okay with it?!
lines.zh: : 我看起来像他妈的没意见吗？！

lines.en: : It does not.
lines.zh: : 不像。

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter if she’s okay with it. She’s going whether she likes it or not and that's final.
lines.zh: : 她有没有意见不重要。不管愿不愿意她都得去，就这么定了。

lines.en: scene chikayumi19
: Who the fuck is gonna watch your sister, then?! You really gonna call out of work just so me and Professor Cockmunch can pretend to talk about our feelings together?
lines.zh: : 那你妹妹谁来看？！你真要请假，就为了让我和鸡巴咀嚼教授一起假装谈谈感受？

lines.en: : I don’t have to leave for work right away. And even if I do, Chinami will be fine for another few minutes.
lines.zh: : 我又不是马上就得去上班。就算我走了，Chinami 再待几分钟也没事。

lines.en: : As long as she’s not going to sleep alone, it’s cool.
lines.zh: : 只要不是让她一个人睡觉就行。

lines.en: : Now stop complaining and let’s go. We've gotten sidetracked enough and I don't want to waste any more of Sensei's time.
lines.zh: : 别抱怨了，走吧。已经跑题够久了，我不想再浪费 Sensei 的时间。

lines.en: : What the fuck is happening to you?...
lines.zh: : 你到底他妈的怎么了？……

lines.en: scene black
And so the three of us embark on the long journey to the second half of town.
lines.zh: 于是我们三个踏上了前往镇子另一头的漫长旅程。

lines.en: Chika remains in the middle at all times, trying to force out a conversation from Yumi, but it’s clear that she’s not going to comply until she gets another apology from me.
lines.zh: Chika 始终走在中间，试图从 Yumi 嘴里撬出点对话，但很明显，在我再道一次歉之前她是不会配合的。

lines.en: Is all of this really happening just because I commented on her self-control the other day?...Or is this still about what happened before that?
lines.zh: 这一切真的只是因为我那天说了她自控力有问题？……还是说这依然是关于在那之前发生的事？

lines.en: Because sometimes, it feels like her default state is just hating my guts.
lines.zh: 因为有时候，感觉她的默认状态就是恨我入骨。

lines.en: And I'm not saying I don't deserve it. I do.
lines.zh: 我也不是说我不该被恨。我该。

lines.en: It's just...exhausting sometimes.
lines.zh: 只是……有时候挺累的。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi1
: Okay. We’re here.
lines.zh: : 好了。到了。

lines.en: : Are you kidding? This place looks sketchy as shit!
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧？这地方看起来可疑得要死！

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m actually with Yumi on this one. Not exactly a great spot to set up a ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这次我站 Yumi。开拉面店选这儿可不太合适。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi2
: Mm!
Chika doesn’t actually say anything to me. She just sort of growls and I manage to understand what she means.
lines.zh: Chika 其实什么也没跟我说。她只是低吼了一声，而我就明白了她的意思。

lines.en: Obviously, I’m perfectly fine going in there with Yumi. I’m not the one who needs convincing.
lines.zh: 显然，我和 Yumi 一起进去完全没问题。需要被说服的不是我。

lines.en: This black-haired delinquent, on the other hand...
lines.zh: 反倒是这个黑发的不良少女……

lines.en: : I’m not even fucking hungry!
lines.zh: : 我他妈根本就不饿！

lines.en: scene ramenyumi1
: You’re always hungry. You never eat.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候都饿。你从来不吃东西。

lines.en: : Besides, Sensei is buying your dinner, so it's not like you even have to worry about money.
lines.zh: : 再说，晚饭是 Sensei 请客，所以你连钱都不用操心。

lines.en: : Wait, I am?
lines.zh: : 等等，我请？

lines.en: scene ramenyumi2
: Mm!
: Okay. Got it.
lines.zh: : 好。明白了。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi3
: Yumi, I don’t know what your deal is because you refuse to ever {i}talk{/i} to me...but you are going in there and settling your differences with each other. That is final.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我不知道你到底怎么回事，因为你从来不肯跟我{i}谈{/i}……但你要走进去，把你们之间的分歧解决掉。就这么定了。

lines.en: : The fuck is going on with you lately? Do you really care about this guy that much?
lines.zh: : 你最近他妈的到底怎么了？你真那么在乎这家伙？

lines.en: : It has nothing to do with how much I care about him. This is about you.
lines.zh: : 这跟我有多在乎他没关系。这是关于你。

lines.en: : I didn’t even do anything, though! I just don’t want to spend all of my free time around some dude who’s willing to fuck anything that moves.
lines.zh: : 可我什么都没做啊！我只是不想把全部空闲时间都花在那种只要会动的都想操的家伙身边。

lines.en: : Sensei isn’t like that.
lines.zh: : Sensei 不是那样的人。

lines.en: : You probably won't get this because you’ve never been in a relationship, but-
lines.zh: : 你大概理解不了，因为你从来没谈过恋爱，不过——

lines.en: scene ramenyumi4
: Neither have you!
lines.zh: : 你也没有啊！

lines.en: : We’re not talking about me right now!
lines.zh: : 现在不是在说我！

lines.en: : All I’m saying is that Sensei is a really good guy if you actually give him a chance!
lines.zh: : 我想说的只是，只要你真的给 Sensei 一个机会，他真的是个很好的人！

lines.en: : And even if you two {i}don’t{/i} make up in there, would it really kill you to give it a shot?
lines.zh: : 而且就算你们俩在里面{i}没能{/i}和好，试一下会死吗？

lines.en: scene ramenyumi6
: I’ll be at my place for the next thirty minutes or so while I get ready. So at least {i}try{/i} to talk about whatever the hell is going on, okay?
lines.zh: : 我接下来三十分钟左右会在家准备出门。所以至少{i}试着{/i}谈谈到底他妈的发生了什么，好吗？

lines.en: : Seriously?...
lines.zh: : 认真的？……

lines.en: : Seriously.
lines.zh: : 认真的。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi7
: Ugh...fine.
lines.zh: : 呜……好吧。

lines.en: : Let’s just get this over with...
lines.zh: : 赶紧把这事儿了结吧……

lines.en: scene ramenyumi8
Yumi opens the door to the ramen shop and the strong scent of pork broth suddenly crosses my path.
lines.zh: Yumi 推开拉面店的门，一股浓郁的猪骨汤味突然扑面而来。

lines.en: I wasn’t hungry moments ago, but now I’m prepared to devour nearly everything on the menu.
lines.zh: 几分钟前我还不饿，现在我已经准备好把菜单上几乎所有东西都吞下去了。

lines.en: : Listen...
lines.zh: : 听着……

lines.en: : I have no idea what happened between you two...but try to be nice to her, okay?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你们俩之间发生了什么……不过尽量对她好一点，好吗？

lines.en: : She only gets this angry when she’s feeling vulnerable, so one wrong move might make her snap.
lines.zh: : 她只有在感到脆弱的时候才会这么生气，所以只要走错一步，她可能就会崩溃。

lines.en: : I’ll be less than a mile away in case anything goes wrong. You know where to find me.
lines.zh: : 万一出什么事，我就在不到一英里外。你知道去哪儿找我。

lines.en: : Got it...
lines.zh: : 明白了……

lines.en: : Thanks for setting this up, Chika. I’m admittedly not great when it comes to fixing things like this.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你安排这些，Chika。说实话，我不太擅长修补这种事。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Sensei. You can make it up to me by just being nice to Yumi, okay?
lines.zh: : 别客气，Sensei。你只要对 Yumi 好一点，就算报答我了，好吗？

lines.en: : And if she doesn't let me?
lines.zh: : 要是她不让我呢？

lines.en: scene ramenyumi9
: Then you figure it out.
lines.zh: : 那你自己想办法。

lines.en: : You're smart, aren't you? I'm sure there's something you can do to make her realize you're not her enemy.
lines.zh: : 你不是很聪明吗？我相信你总有办法让她意识到你不是她的敌人。

lines.en: : And hey, even if you can't, trying is good enough for me.
lines.zh: : 而且嘿，就算做不到，对我而言你肯试就够了。

lines.en: scene black
Chika and I say our goodbyes and I firmly believe she is putting too much faith in me.
lines.zh: 我和 Chika 道了别，而我坚信她对我寄予了过多的信任。

lines.en: Regardless, I do as I'm told and make my way into the ramen shop as well...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我照她说的做，也走进了那家拉面店……

lines.en: scene ramenyumi10
Yumi and I sit at the counter of an unfamiliar business, overcome by the awkward silence filling in the blanks between us.
lines.zh: Yumi 和我坐在一家陌生店铺的吧台前，弥漫在我们之间的尴尬沉默填满了所有空隙。

lines.en: The sizzling of yakitori and scattered sounds of a dishwashing hose make me all too aware of how hard it is to talk to her.
lines.zh: 烤鸡肉串的滋滋声和洗碗水管的零星声响，让我格外清楚地意识到，跟她说话有多难。

lines.en: Before long, a girl around the same age as her approaches.
lines.zh: 没过多久，一个和她年纪相仿的女孩走了过来。

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : Please take your time looking over the menu and let me know if you have any questions.
lines.zh: : 请慢慢看菜单，有任何问题随时告诉我。

lines.en: : Sure, thanks...
lines.zh: : 好的，谢谢……

lines.en: : You are welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : I will now return to the kitchen and pretend that I do not hear what you two talk about.
lines.zh: : 我现在回厨房，并假装听不见你们俩在说什么。

lines.en: The girl disappears through a curtain and, seconds later, the sounds of the dishwashing hose come back in full force.
lines.zh: 女孩掀开门帘消失了，几秒后，洗碗水管的声音又完整地回来了。

lines.en: : Yumi, I-
lines.zh: : Yumi，我——

lines.en: : The cafe called me.
lines.zh: : 那家咖啡店给我打电话了。

lines.en: : I didn’t get the job.
lines.zh: : 我没被录用。

lines.en: : Something about not having enough hours to give out or some bullshit. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 说什么工时不够分配之类的屁话。我也不知道。

lines.en: : When did this happen?
lines.zh: : 什么时候的事？

lines.en: : A few days ago.
lines.zh: : 几天前。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} why you’ve been in an even worse mood than normal lately?
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}你最近心情比平时还糟？

lines.en: scene ramenyumi11
: I don’t fucking know, man.
lines.zh: : 我他妈不知道，老兄。

lines.en: : There are plenty of reasons to be in a bad mood.
lines.zh: : 心情差的理由多的是。

lines.en: : Being forced to come out here with you is just another one of them.
lines.zh: : 被逼着跟你出来又是其中一个。

lines.en: Maybe I should bring up the comment I made the other day in class?
lines.zh: 也许我该提一下那天在课上说的那句话？

lines.en: It might be good to...push this chance and try to get her to open up while I still have it.
lines.zh: 趁着还有机会，推一把，试着让她敞开心扉，也许是好事。

lines.en: : Did the thing I said about you having a self-control problem add to that?
lines.zh: : 我说你有自控力问题那句话，也加重了这个吗？

lines.en: : You tell me, smartass.
lines.zh: : 你自己说呢，聪明鬼。

lines.en: : Imagine somebody twice your size randomly stuck their tongue down your throat and then started telling {i}you{/i} you had issues.
lines.zh: : 想象一下，有个块头是你两倍的人突然把舌头伸进你喉咙里，然后开始跟{i}你{/i}说你有毛病。

lines.en: : How the fuck would you feel?
lines.zh: : 你会他妈的什么感觉？

lines.en: : I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 对不起……

lines.en: : Yeah. You’ve already said that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你已经说过了。

lines.en: : And now you’re doing all this shit to try and make up for it and everything just feels fake as hell.
lines.zh: : 现在你又做这些事想弥补，一切都假得要命。

lines.en: : You’re a shit human. And you know damn well that there isn’t any place out there that’s going to give me a chance.
lines.zh: : 你是个烂人。而且你他妈的清楚得很，这世上没有任何地方会给我机会。

lines.en: : So now, you’re taking advantage of me and buying me food and saying you’ll help me find a job and shit...but why?
lines.zh: : 所以现在，你在利用我，给我买吃的，说要帮我找工作什么的……可为什么呢？

lines.en: : You think I’m gonna fall for you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会爱上你？

lines.en: : Is that what it is?
lines.zh: : 就是这个原因吗？

lines.en: : If I just swallow my pride and suck your dick already, will you at least just leave me the fuck alone after that?
lines.zh: : 要是我咽下自尊，直接把你的鸡巴含了，之后你就能他妈的离我远点了吗？

lines.en: : Is that really what I have to do? Because at this point, it honestly might be worth it.
lines.zh: : 我真非这么做不可吗？因为到了这个地步，说实话可能还挺值的。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi12
: Yumi...
lines.zh: : Yumi……

lines.en: : Point is...I don’t want to be anywhere near you anymore.
lines.zh: : 重点是……我再也不想待在你身边了。

lines.en: : I don’t want your fucking help.
lines.zh: : 我不要你他妈的帮助。

lines.en: : Just let me do my own thing in peace like I’ve been doin’ my entire life.
lines.zh: : 就让我像我这辈子一直做的那样，安安静静过我自己的日子。

lines.en: : I’m not meant to fuckin’ act like everybody else. I’m a loner. A degenerate. A fucking thief.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的注定没法像其他人那样活着。我是个独行侠。一个堕落的人。一个他妈的小偷。

lines.en: : I’m everything horrible wrapped into one girl and there’s no way anyone like me could ever get along with some fucking 'player' like you.
lines.zh: : 一切糟糕的东西都裹在我这一个女孩身上，像我这样的人，绝不可能和你这种「花花公子」处得来。

lines.en: : But yet here I am, about to eat dinner with you in some fucking ramen shop less than a mile away from where you stole my first kiss.
lines.zh: : 可现在我他妈的就在这儿，在离你偷走我初吻不到一英里的拉面店里，要跟你一起吃晚饭。

lines.en: : Life is fucking stupid. I just want everything to stop.
lines.zh: : 人生真是他妈的蠢。我只想让一切都停下来。

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : You know what? No. I’m done with this.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？算了。我受够了。

lines.en: : I'll go tell Chika I backed out.
lines.zh: : 我去跟 Chika 说我不干了。

lines.en: : Enjoy your fucking ramen.
lines.zh: : 好好享用你那该死的拉面吧。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi14
Yumi storms out of the ramen shop.
lines.zh: Yumi 冲出了拉面店。

lines.en: I don’t even try to stop her.
lines.zh: 我甚至没试着拦她。

lines.en: All I can really do is give her space at this point.
lines.zh: 到了这个地步，我能做的真的只有给她空间。

lines.en: Sure, there are plenty of things I want to say, but it's not like she'd be able to hear them in her current condition.
lines.zh: 当然，我有很多话想说，但她现在这个状态，根本听不进去。

lines.en: And I don’t blame her.
lines.zh: 我也不怪她。

lines.en: I know I’m a horrible person, but...
lines.zh: 我知道我是个糟糕的人，可是……

lines.en: Why {i}did{/i} I kiss her?
lines.zh: 我为什么要{i}吻{/i}她？

lines.en: I still don’t understand.
lines.zh: 我到现在也不明白。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi15
A moment of silence passes by before the shop’s bathroom door opens and an older woman steps out.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默过去后，店里的洗手间门开了，一个上了年纪的女人走了出来。

lines.en: She takes a seat where Yumi was just moments ago and immediately pulls a cigarette from one of the pockets of her leather jacket.
lines.zh: 她在 Yumi 刚才坐的位置上坐下，立刻从皮夹克的口袋里掏出一根烟。

lines.en: : Girl problems?
lines.zh: : 女人的问题？

lines.en: : I guess that’s one way to put it.
lines.zh: : 可以这么说吧。

lines.en: : Sounded like a real brat, if you ask me.
lines.zh: : 要我说，听起来是个十足的小屁孩。

lines.en: : She can be. This was kind of my fault, though.
lines.zh: : 她有时候是。不过这事也算我的错。

lines.en: : You cheat on her or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 你劈腿了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Nothing like that. Just...did some things she didn’t particularly agree with.
lines.zh: : 不是那种事。只是……做了些她不太认同的事。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi16
: Put it in the wrong hole or something? Gotta admit, I'd be mad too.
lines.zh: : 插错洞了还是怎么的？说实话，换我我也会生气。

lines.en: : What? No. Nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。不是那种事。

lines.en: : The fuck did you do, then?
lines.zh: : 那你他妈的做了什么？

lines.en: : Not much out there that can get a girl {i}that{/i} pissed off. Guess everyone's a little different, though.
lines.zh: : 能让一个女孩{i}气成那样{/i}的不多。不过话说回来，每个人都不一样吧。

lines.en: : Just...might have jumped the gun on making the first move.
lines.zh: : 就是……可能抢先一步，出手太早了。

lines.en: : Tongue or no tongue?
lines.zh: : 用没用舌头？

lines.en: : Is that important?
lines.zh: : 这重要吗？

lines.en: : Not really, I guess. Just curious.
lines.zh: : 大概不重要。只是好奇。

lines.en: : She sounded young. She like a...daughter’s friend or something? Or are you just that fucked up?
lines.zh: : 她听起来挺小。她是……你女儿的朋友什么的？还是说你就是这么变态？

lines.en: : You really don’t hold anything back, do you?
lines.zh: : 你还真是口无遮拦啊。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi17
: What's the point of holdin' anything back? We’re all gonna fuckin’ die someday. Might as well live it up while we still can.
lines.zh: : 藏着掖着有什么意义？我们他妈的早晚都得死。趁还活着不如活得痛快。

lines.en: : Hard to do that when you're constantly tiptoeing around shit.
lines.zh: : 老是绕着事情走，是做不到这一点的。

lines.en: : Well...I guess you've got a point there.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你说得也有道理。

lines.en: : Was I right about the daughter thing at least? You look old enough to have kids.
lines.zh: : 那「女儿」那件事我至少猜对了吧？你看上去年纪够当爹了。

lines.en: : No daughters...just a niece. How about you?
lines.zh: : 没有女儿……只有一个侄女。你呢？

lines.en: scene ramenyumi18
The woman takes a drag from her cigarette and waves over the [young_girl] who had tried to take my order earlier.
lines.zh: 女人吸了一口烟，朝刚才想帮我点单的那个[young_girl]挥了挥手。

lines.en: : Tsu-chan, give me the usual. This weird guy will have what I'm having as well.
lines.zh: : Tsu 酱，给我来老样子。这个怪人跟我一样。

lines.en: : Understood. Please let me know if there is anything else I can do for you.
lines.zh: : 明白了。如果还有其他需要，请随时告诉我。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi19
The ramen girl, once again, disappears into the back room and begins to prepare our order.
lines.zh: 拉面女孩又一次消失在后厨，开始准备我们的餐点。

lines.en: : What if I don’t like “The usual?”
lines.zh: : 要是我不喜欢「老样子」怎么办？

lines.en: : You’ll like it. Shit's fuckin' unreal. Best damn thing in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 你会喜欢的。那玩意儿他妈的好吃到不真实。Kumon-mi 里最他妈棒的东西。

lines.en: : But hey, if you don’t like it for some weird fuckin’ reason, just give me whatever you don’t finish and I'll take care of it.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，要是出于什么古怪的原因你不喜欢，把你吃不完的给我，我来解决。

lines.en: : Could eat ten of these fuckin’ things.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的能吃十碗。

lines.en: : Thanks, I guess. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢了，大概吧。我很感激。

lines.en: scene ramenyumi20
: Appreciate what? You’re the one payin’.
lines.zh: : 感激什么？你才是付钱的那个。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : That’s the price for my advice. You got a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 那是我的建议费。你有意见？

lines.en: : A small one, yeah. You haven’t given me any advice yet.
lines.zh: : 有一点，对。你还没给我任何建议呢。

lines.en: : Heh. Right. Well how about this, then-
lines.zh: : 呵。也是。那这样吧——

lines.en: : Stick with your niece and don’t ever have any kids of your own.
lines.zh: : 守着你的侄女，永远别生自己的孩子。

lines.en: : Shit's not all it's made out to be.
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿可不像宣传的那么好。

lines.en: : Thanks. I wasn’t planning on having kids, but I will definitely file that advice under more reasons to not have them.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我本来也没打算要孩子，不过这条建议我肯定会归档，成为更多不生的理由。

lines.en: : You do you, man.
lines.zh: : 随你便，老兄。

lines.en: : And good luck with that girl.
lines.zh: : 还有，祝你和那个姑娘顺利。

lines.en: : I’m sure everythin’ will work out as long as you don’t be a fuckin' douche about it.
lines.zh: : 只要你别他妈的当个混蛋，我相信一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : I will do my very best to not be a douche about it, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我会尽我所能不当混蛋的，谢了。

lines.en: : I don't need your thanks. The free dinner is more than enough.
lines.zh: : 我不需要你的感谢。这顿免费的晚饭就够多了。

lines.en: : Also, might wanna think again before comin' out here next time. This part of town ain't really the right place for people like you.
lines.zh: : 还有，下次来这一带之前最好再想想。镇子这一片不太适合你这种人。

lines.en: : People like me?
lines.zh: : 我这种人？

lines.en: : People who let girls like {i}me{/i} walk all over 'em without puttin' up a fight.
lines.zh: : 那种任由{i}我{/i}这样的女人踩在头上、连反抗都不反抗的人。

lines.en: : In my defense, you are rather intimidating.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你确实挺吓人的。

lines.en: : Guess I am, huh?
lines.zh: : 大概是吧，嗯？

lines.en: : Either way, watch your back around here.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，在这儿小心点。

lines.en: : Ain't nothin' good on this side of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 这一片没一个好东西。

lines.en: : Just a bunch of lowlives and people pretendin' that it ain't their own shit decisions that landed 'em here.
lines.zh: : 全是些人渣，还有假装不是自己那堆烂决定把自己害到这儿来的人。

lines.en: : File that in whatever fuckin' file you think it's worth filin' it in, I guess. And I'll take a beer as payment for that.
lines.zh: : 你爱把它归到哪个该死的档案里就归到哪儿吧。这回我要一瓶啤酒当报酬。

lines.en: : Sure. But please stop giving me advice before I go broke.
lines.zh: : 行。不过请你别再给我建议了，趁我还没破产。

lines.en: scene black
Despite buying her dinner, the unknown woman and I didn’t talk much as soon after the food arrived...but I felt oddly comfortable sitting next to her.
lines.zh: 尽管是我请的晚饭，食物上来之后，这个陌生女人和我就不怎么说话了……但坐在她旁边，我却莫名地自在。

lines.en: Something about the way she spoke to me made it seem like she was genuinely trying to deter me from ever being familiar enough with this half of town to have a {i}usual{/i} at a local restaurant.
lines.zh: 她跟我说话的方式，让人觉得她是真心想让我别和镇子这一半熟到能在本地餐馆有{i}「老样子」{/i}的程度。

lines.en: And while I'd like to say I will take her advice to heart-
lines.zh: 虽然我想说我会把她的建议放在心上——

lines.en: I know I won't.
lines.zh: 但我知道我不会。

lines.en: Regardless, I wish her the best.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，祝她好运。

lines.en: Wherever the wind takes her.
lines.zh: 无论风把她吹向哪里。
